text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Ahahahahaha...!!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Gh…… ngh……!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"In the lead... it's Still in Love! She 
crosses the line...!"

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Hah... Hah... *pant*... *pant*...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Did I... lose...?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Come... fully prepared...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Why am I... the loser...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Guh...!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Ufu... f-fufufu-fufu...! Ahahaha 
hahahaha!!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"Aaaah— I just can't get enough of 
this...!!"

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Fleeing in panic! Getting caught! 
Struggling frantically! And running away 
again!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
That expression! That scream! It gets me 
even moooore fired up—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: No... I can't...!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Everyone is... watching...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...What is this... even...?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Still-san.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"...I apologize... for presenting such an 
unseemly sight to you."

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...... You don't really need to apologize 
to me.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, surely you haven't 
forgotten? The battle... is far from over.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
The next showdown is in a month and a 
half. ...The Yushun Himba (Japanese Oaks).

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Next... next race...? My next race—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
My next race...! Ufufu... Ehehe... 
Ahaha...!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Yes! The Oaks...! You're already looking 
forward to what comes next...! Isn't that 
wonderful!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure you will be... even more 
delicious than you are today...♪

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Ah... You're...—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Are you going to call it unladylike 
too? How rude of you... ♪

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: (...Even you...)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(The one who called it "unbecoming"... 
...should have been none other than 
herself...)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(Perhaps... I had mistaken her true 
essence all along.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(She possesses—conflicting senses of 
self.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(That fleeting girl... and a "monster"... 
just like her—)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I... I am deeply sorry! I've made... yet 
another... blunder...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...What on earth... is that?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ――…… Um, well……

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: That is... "not normal."

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Whenever running and racing are involved, 
it always appears— something bearing your 
form.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Ever since we ran together last year, I've 
felt this eerie "presence." Ferocious, 
combative... exceedingly dangerous.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: “She” is—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: An "impulse"... and a "thirst."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Sprouted when I first encountered racing 
and was utterly captivated by it—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Middled within it was an... "urge." An 
urge to "devour."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"The fighting spirit, the very soul of the 
strong. I want to sip upon it—"

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...Those kinds of things just end up 
coming out.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...Perhaps... it is something akin to an 
'instinct' within me.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Instinct... you say...?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I understand what you're saying, 
Groove-san. And I understand why you'd be 
on guard, too.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Yet I... cannot fight without "her." "She" 
is me, too... We can never be separated.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...I'll take my leave for today.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"I look forward to working with you 
again... during the Oaks..."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Without fail... I will be the one to win.

Having returned to the waiting room, 
Admire Groove has been lost in deep 
thought with a troubled look on her face.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
choice_data_list: (Prying would be a bad move, though...)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(...What she calls her "instinct"... When 
that comes out, her running is pure 
menace.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(And yet, her outward self... her 
'reason,' so to speak, somehow shunned 
letting her 'instinct' show.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: (Just why... on earth?)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(To seek victory even at the cost of 
showing an undesirable side of herself. 
What could possibly be waiting for her on 
the other side?)
choice_data_list:
Let's go back, Alv. We can review once 
we're home.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(Thinking about it any more won't give me 
the answers... right now, preparing for 
the Oaks is my top priority.)
